activities.title: Finish My Drawing
activities.description: Draw a simple squiggle or shape on paper and have your child turn it into something -- an animal, a monster, a car.
steps: Draw a random squiggle or circle
Ask them to turn it into a picture of anything they want
Have them tell you a one-sentence story about it

activities.title: Pretend Play Swap
activities.description: Act out a familiar story together, but swap roles halfway through -- the wolf becomes kind, the hero becomes silly.
steps: Pick a familiar story or make one up
Act it out together, each playing a character
Halfway through, swap roles and keep going

activities.title: Make Up a Silly Song
activities.description: Pick a everyday routine, like brushing teeth, and make up a short silly song about it together.
steps: Pick a daily routine as the topic
Hum a simple tune and take turns adding a line
Sing the finished song together

activities.title: Story Dice
activities.description: Write 6 random words on paper slips, pick 3, and build a short story together using all of them.
steps: Write 6 random words (object, animal, place)
Pick 3 at random
Build a short story together that uses all three

activities.title: Build Something New
activities.description: Using household items, build an invention that solves a made-up problem, like "a machine that feeds the dog."
materials: Cardboard, tape, household odds and ends
steps: Pick a silly problem to solve
Build a contraption out of things around the house
Explain how it works, even if it's imaginary

activities.title: Comic Strip
activities.description: Fold a paper into 4 panels and draw a tiny comic strip together about something that happened today.
steps: Fold paper into 4 boxes
Pick a small moment from today
Draw it as a 4-panel comic, one event per box

activities.title: Mini Movie
activities.description: Write and film a 1-minute video together on a phone -- a mini mystery, commercial, or news report.
steps: Pick a simple idea -- a commercial for a pretend product, or a mini mystery
Plan 3-4 short scenes
Film it together and watch it back

activities.title: Alternate Ending
activities.description: Pick a book or movie you both know and rewrite the ending together -- what would you change?
steps: Pick a story you both know well
Talk about the real ending
Make up a different ending together and explain why it's better or worse

activities.title: Remix a Rhythm
activities.description: Using household objects as instruments (pots, pencils, hands), compose a short rhythm pattern together.
materials: Pots, pans, or anything that makes a sound
steps: Pick 2-3 household "instruments"
Take turns adding a beat to build a pattern
Perform the finished rhythm together

activities.title: Photo Essay
activities.description: Pick a theme (like "small joys" or "our neighborhood") and take 5 photos together that tell a story about it.
steps: Agree on a theme
Take 5 photos that fit it, out and about or at home
Pick your favorite 3 and talk about why they work

activities.title: Collaborative Short Story
activities.description: Write a story together one paragraph at a time, each person continuing where the other left off, with no planning allowed.
materials: Paper or a shared notes doc
steps: Write an opening paragraph
Pass it back and forth, each adding a paragraph without discussing ahead
Read the finished story out loud together

activities.title: Design a Playlist
activities.description: Build a themed playlist together (like "songs for a road trip") and each explain why you picked your songs.
steps: Pick a theme for the playlist
Each add 3-4 songs that fit it
Listen through and talk about what each song adds
